scope: 717 scripts, direct activation targets and up to two helper layers with SZONE location-count checks. Candidates need source/data review; count checks in other modes can be unrelated.

candidates.name: Crewal Meeting
candidates.targetBody:
function s.target(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	if chk==0 then return (Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_SZONE)>0
		or Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.costfilter,tp,LOCATION_SZONE,0,1,nil))
		and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(aux.NecroValleyFilter(s.plfilter),tp,LOCATION_DECK+LOCATION_GRAVE+LOCATION_REMOVED,0,1,nil) end
end

candidates.targetBody:
function s.settg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,chkc)

end

candidates.name: Gravinity Gravity Protection
candidates.targetBody:
function s.target(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	local b1=Duel.GetFlagEffect(tp,id)==0 and Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_SZONE)>0
		and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(aux.NecroValleyFilter(s.placefilter),tp,LOCATION_MZONE+LOCATION_GRAVE,0,1,nil)
	local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.matfilter,tp,LOCATION_MZONE+LOCATION_SZONE,0,nil)
	local b2=Duel.GetFlagEffect(tp,id+100)==0 and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.synfilter,tp,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,1,nil,mg)
	local b3=Duel.GetFlagEffect(tp,id+200)==0 and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.zonefilter,tp,LOCATION_SZONE,0,1,nil,tp)
	if chk==0 then return b1 or b2 or b3 end
	local opts={}
	local vals={}
	if b1 then opts[#opts+1]=aux.Stringid(STRING_ID,1) vals[#vals+1]=1 end
	if b2 then opts[#opts+1]=aux.Stringid(STRING_ID,2) vals[#vals+1]=2 end
	if b3 then opts[#opts+1]=aux.Stringid(STRING_ID,3) vals[#vals+1]=3 end
	local sel=Duel.SelectOption(tp,table.unpack(opts))
	local op=vals[sel+1]
	e:SetLabel(op)
	Duel.RegisterFlagEffect(tp,id+(op-1)*100,RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END,0,1)
end

candidates.name: Red-Eyes Roar
candidates.targetBody:
function s.target(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,chkc)
	if chkc then return e:GetLabel()==2 and chkc:IsLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and s.eqtarget(chkc,e) end
	local b1=Duel.GetFlagEffect(tp,id)==0 and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.thfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil)
	local b2=Duel.GetFlagEffect(tp,id+100)==0 and Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_SZONE)>0
		and Duel.IsExistingTarget(s.eqtarget,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE,1,nil,e)
		and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(aux.NecroValleyFilter(s.eqfilter),tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK+LOCATION_GRAVE,0,1,nil)
	if chk==0 then return b1 or b2 end
	local op=aux.SelectFromOptions(tp,
		{b1,aux.Stringid(STRING_ID,0),1},
		{b2,aux.Stringid(STRING_ID,1),2})
	e:SetLabel(op)
	if op==1 then
		if e:IsCostChecked() then
			e:SetCategory(CATEGORY_TOHAND+CATEGORY_SEARCH)
			e:SetProperty(0)
			Duel.RegisterFlagEffect(tp,id,RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END,0,1)
		end
		Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_TOHAND,nil,1,tp,LOCATION_DECK)
	elseif op==2 then
		if e:IsCostChecked() then
			e:SetCategory(CATEGORY_EQUIP)
			e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET)
			Duel.RegisterFlagEffect(tp,id+100,RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END,0,1)
		end
		Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_EQUIP)
		Duel.SelectTarget(tp,s.eqtarget,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE,1,1,nil,e)
		Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_EQUIP,nil,1,tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK+LOCATION_GRAVE)
	end
end

operationDrivenScan.name: Galataxian Battle Preparation
operationDrivenScan.targetBody:
function s.settg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,chkc)
	if chkc then return chkc:IsControler(tp) and chkc:IsLocation(LOCATION_REMOVED) and s.setfilter(chkc) end
	local ft=Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_SZONE)
	if e:IsHasType(EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE) and not e:GetHandler():IsLocation(LOCATION_SZONE) then ft=ft-1 end
	local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(function(c,te) return s.setfilter(c) and c:IsCanBeEffectTarget(te) end,tp,LOCATION_REMOVED,0,nil,e)
	if chk==0 then return g:CheckSubGroup(s.setgroup,1,3,ft) end
	Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SET)
	local sg=g:SelectSubGroup(tp,s.setgroup,false,1,3,ft)
	Duel.SetTargetCard(sg)
end

operationDrivenScan.name: Windborne Divine Whirlwind
operationDrivenScan.targetBody:
function s.target(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,chkc)
	if chkc then return false end
	local ft=Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_SZONE)
	if e:IsHasType(EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE) and not e:GetHandler():IsLocation(LOCATION_SZONE) then ft=ft-1 end
	local b1=Duel.IsExistingTarget(aux.NecroValleyFilter(s.thcardfilter),tp,LOCATION_GRAVE,0,1,nil)
	local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(aux.NecroValleyFilter(function(c,te) return s.setcardfilter(c) and c:IsCanBeEffectTarget(te) end),tp,LOCATION_GRAVE,0,nil,e)
	local b2=g:CheckSubGroup(s.setgroup,1,2,ft)
	if chk==0 then return b1 or b2 end
	local op=b1 and b2 and Duel.SelectOption(tp,1190,1153) or (b1 and 0 or 1)
	e:SetLabel(op)
	Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_TARGET)
	if op==0 then
		Duel.SelectTarget(tp,aux.NecroValleyFilter(s.thcardfilter),tp,LOCATION_GRAVE,0,1,2,nil)
	else
		local sg=g:SelectSubGroup(tp,s.setgroup,false,1,2,ft)
		Duel.SetTargetCard(sg)
	end
end

operationDrivenScan.name: Floowandereeze and the Hot Winds
operationDrivenScan.targetBody:
function s.target(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	local place,banish=s.options(e,tp)
	if chk==0 then return place or banish end
	local options,modes={},{}
	if place then options[#options+1]=aux.Stringid(id,2) modes[#modes+1]=1 end
	if banish then options[#options+1]=aux.Stringid(id,3) modes[#modes+1]=2 end
	if place and banish and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.tribute,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,1,nil) then
		options[#options+1]=aux.Stringid(id,4)
		modes[#modes+1]=3
	end
	e:SetLabel(modes[#modes==1 and 1 or Duel.SelectOption(tp,table.unpack(options))+1])
end
